bullets: The bilingual carousel on what a first session feels like earned the most saves this week, especially from Spanish-speaking readers.
Fourteen people inquired across the website and Instagram, with nine booking a free intro consultation and six confirming a full session.
The first Take Un Momentico episode held viewers for an average of 19 minutes, giving us eight calm short clips for next week.
Two bilingual South Florida podcasts replied to guest pitches, and seven local directory listings are now verified.
For you this week: two post batches are waiting for your OK, plus two inquiry replies and one testimonial permission check.

monthlyReport.headline: Steady, grounded visibility built from one monthly conversation
whatWorked: Educational 'first session' and 'messages from loved ones' posts brought calmer, higher-trust inquiries than general quotes.
Bilingual pages performed nearly evenly (57% English, 43% Spanish), confirming strong demand for Spanish-language clarity.
Clipping Take Un Momentico into 8 short reflections covered two full weeks of Reels and Shorts from a single sitting.
